Delivery & Coordination: Effective coordination and delivery of approved undergraduate and/or postgraduate modules
Alignment of teaching practices with approved curricula and learning outcomes
Maintenance of current learning materials and learning activities on eFundi or approved NWU LMS
Use of structured learning pathways and communication to support student engagement and completion
Assessment & Moderation: Quality and compliance of assessment design, moderation and feedback practices
Timely and accurate assessment and moderation in accordance with faculty guidelines
Evidence-based assessment improvement through moderation findings and reflection
Student Support & Supervision: Effective supervision and academic support of students (undergraduate/postgraduate)
Contribution to student throughput, retention and academic development
Implementation of structured consultation, support and referral mechanisms
Pedagogical Innovation: Integration of innovative, blended or technology-enhanced teaching practices
Continuous improvement of teaching approaches informed by evaluation and reflection
Quality Assurance: Participation in module evaluation, review and continuous improvement processes
Contribution to programme review, accreditation readiness and teaching quality reporting

Research Outputs: Production of accredited research outputs aligned with institutional targets
Contribution to peer-reviewed publications, books or conference outputs
Production of research-informed scholarly resources (where applicable)
Postgraduate Supervision: Effective supervision and progression of postgraduate students
Contribution to postgraduate throughput and completion
Research Engagement: Participation in research projects, collaborations or scholarly networks
Engagement in research capacity development activities
Funding & Recognition: Submission or acquisition of research funding or grants (where applicable)
Recognition through citations, peer review, editorial work or scholarly impact

Community Engagement / Social Responsive: Meaningful engagement with communities aligned to disciplinary expertise
Integration of community engagement into teaching or research activities
Contribution to socially responsive projects or partnerships
Documentation and reporting of community engagement outcomes

Academic Leadership & Administration: Effective participation in academic committees or governance structures
Contribution to programme, school or faculty administration
Leadership in curriculum development, quality assurance or academic planning
Support of institutional initiatives and strategic objectives

OHS: Compliance with institutional Occupational Health and Safety requirements
